purpose: Ground truth for controlled missing-consequence recovery experiment

T301-041.known_cause_field: Unloading continues after target inventory; incorrect inventory estimate; level controller fails to reduce inflow.
T301-041.withheld_consequence_field: Liquid hexane spills from tank opening or overflow path; flammable vapor may form; fire or flash fire possible if ignition occurs.
T301-041.withheld_recommendation_field: Review high-level alarm and independent overfill shutdown; define unloading stop procedure; verify containment capacity.
T301-041.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-043.known_cause_field: Level instrument under-reads; calibration drift; impulse connection obstructed.
T301-043.withheld_consequence_field: Operator delays stopping inflow; overfill and release of hexane.
T301-043.withheld_recommendation_field: Provide independent level verification and proof-test critical level instruments.
T301-043.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-046.known_cause_field: Transfer pump continues drawing liquid; inflow is lower than outflow.
T301-046.withheld_consequence_field: Low inventory; downstream feed interruption; pump may run dry if suction is lost.
T301-046.withheld_recommendation_field: Review low-level alarm and pump trip requirements; establish minimum operating inventory.
T301-046.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-048.known_cause_field: Level instrument over-reads and controller reduces or stops inflow.
T301-048.withheld_consequence_field: Tank inventory falls below target; downstream supply may be interrupted.
T301-048.withheld_recommendation_field: Provide independent level cross-check and instrument diagnostics.
T301-048.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-050.known_cause_field: Water enters through an open connection, condensation, or incomplete draining after cleaning.
T301-050.withheld_consequence_field: Water contamination may affect product quality and may contribute to freezing or drain-line problems under sufficiently cold conditions.
T301-050.withheld_recommendation_field: Verify material identity and water content; inspect drains and prevent water ingress.
T301-050.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-052.known_cause_field: Transfer connection or tank selection error.
T301-052.withheld_consequence_field: Contamination and possible incompatibility; downstream product or operation affected.
T301-052.withheld_recommendation_field: Use positive identification of tank, transfer hose, and material before transfer.
T301-052.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-055.known_cause_field: Supplier quality variation or inadequate receipt checks.
T301-055.withheld_consequence_field: Off-spec material; process performance may change; consequences depend on impurity.
T301-055.withheld_recommendation_field: Define acceptance specification and hold material pending identity/quality verification.
T301-055.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-059.known_cause_field: Seal wear, incorrect installation, shaft misalignment, or vibration.
T301-059.withheld_consequence_field: Hexane release and pool formation; flammable vapor; potential fire or explosion if ignited.
T301-059.withheld_recommendation_field: Inspect seal condition and alignment; provide suitable leak detection and isolation.
T301-059.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-061.known_cause_field: Drain valve left open, damaged seat, or accidental operation.
T301-061.withheld_consequence_field: Hexane discharge to surrounding area; vapor generation and potential ignition.
T301-061.withheld_recommendation_field: Use valve lineup checks and suitable protection against unintended opening.
T301-061.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-067.known_cause_field: Outlet or vent path obstructed; vapor generation continues.
T301-067.withheld_consequence_field: Pressure rise; tank damage or rupture if design capacity is exceeded; hexane release and fire/explosion potential.
T301-067.withheld_recommendation_field: Verify vent/relief design and inspect for blockage; assess credible overpressure cases.
T301-067.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-069.known_cause_field: External fire heats tank contents and increases vapor generation.
T301-069.withheld_consequence_field: Pressure rise, tank damage, loss of containment, escalation to fire involving released hexane.
T301-069.withheld_recommendation_field: Evaluate fire exposure and tank protection with qualified engineers.
T301-069.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.

T301-083.known_cause_field: Prolonged solar exposure raises stored liquid temperature.
T301-083.withheld_consequence_field: Higher vapor generation and pressure; potential exceedance of tank/vent capacity depending on conditions.
T301-083.withheld_recommendation_field: Assess ambient heat exposure and verify pressure/venting design.
T301-083.note: Held out from Version C. This value is ground truth for the controlled experiment, not evidence available to the model.
